options: it helps identify superior animals for selection
topic_questions.explanation: Records of weight, milk and eggs are needed for selection.

topic_questions.text: Which of the following is a measurable trait used for selecting dairy cows?
topic_questions.explanation: Milk yield and butterfat content are the main criteria.

topic_questions.text: Which of the following traits is considered when selecting layers?
topic_questions.explanation: Number and size of eggs are key.

topic_questions.text: Which of the following traits is considered in selecting beef cattle?
topic_questions.explanation: Beef breeds are selected for growth and carcass quality.

topic_questions.explanation: A nucleus herd supplies improved breeding stock to farmers.

topic_questions.text: Conservation of indigenous breeds is important to
options: preserve genes for adaptation and disease resistance
topic_questions.explanation: Local breeds carry useful genes for the future.
